mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, field_code, field_name, field_type, required, multiple, field_prompt, example_value, regex_rule, confidence_threshold, sort_no, create_time FROM extract_field WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extract_field (template_id, field_code, field_name, field_type, required, multiple, field_prompt, example_value, regex_rule, confidence_threshold, sort_no, create_time) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{fieldCode}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{required}, #{multiple}, #{fieldPrompt}, #{exampleValue}, #{regexRule}, #{confidenceThreshold}, #{sortNo}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE extract_field SET field_code = #{fieldCode}, field_name = #{fieldName}, field_type = #{fieldType}, required = #{required}, multiple = #{multiple}, field_prompt = #{fieldPrompt}, example_value = #{exampleValue}, regex_rule = #{regexRule}, confidence_threshold = #{confidenceThreshold}, sort_no = #{sortNo} WHERE id = #{id} AND template_id = #{templateId}
